column1:
『ユークリッド王国の歴史』
<pause>
ユークリッド王国は約１２０年の
歴史がある。
<pause>
ユークリッド王国の前身、ユーク
リッド共和国は三つの部族が合わ
さった国である。
<pause>
一つはベネツィア大陸を治めてい
たデロイノ族。
<pause>
一つはユークリッド大陸南部を治
めていたメイルガン族。
<pause>
（五十年前に崩壊した地下墓地は
この部族が建設したという説があ
る）
<pause>
そしてユークリッド大陸北部を治
めていたユークリッド族。
<pause>
現在の王であるユークリッド２１
世＝ラルフ＝ド＝ユークリッドニ
アの祖先である。{END}
column2:
“History of the Kingdom of Euclid”
<pause>
The Kingdom of Euclid has a history
of about one hundred twenty years.
<pause>
Before the kingdom was established,
there was the Euclidean Republic--a
union of three clans.
<pause>
One clan was called Deroino, which
governed the Venezian continent.
<pause>
Another clan was known as Mailgan,
which governed the southern
portion of the Euclid continent.
<pause>
(It is theorized that this is the
group which constructed the
mausoleum which was destroyed
fifty years ago.)
<pause>
The final of the three clans was
called Euclid, which governed the
northern portion of the Euclid
continent.
<pause>
The present king, Ralph D. Euclidonia,
is of the twenty-first generation of
the Euclid family.{END}

column1:
『世界の少数部族』
<pause>
世界中には１００人以下の小部族
が約２５０あると言われている。
<pause>
その内の一つに非常に珍しい文化
を持った部族がある。
<pause>
それがジャポンである。
<pause>
ジャポンで一番知られているのは
忍者であるが、
<pause>
その他に、完全に外部との接触を
拒んできたこの部族ならではの道
具類があるという。{END}
column2:
“Minority Groups of the World”
<pause>
There is an estimated two hundred
fifty small clans of people in the
world, each with a population of a
hundred or less.
<pause>
One of these groups, known as
Japon, possesses a notable,
distinctly unusual culture.
<pause>
Japon is most famous for its ninja,
who are very secretive.
<pause>
It is thought this group has means
to completely conceal itself from
the outside world, as all attempts to
contact their culture directly have
ended in failure.{END}

column1:
『エルフ族について』
<pause>
エルフは長命であり、また潜在能
力として持つ魔力や姿の美しさな
ど、人間とは違った特徴を持って
いる。
<pause>
そのエルフの発祥の地はいまだに
定かではない。
<pause>
現在はトレントの森という説が有
力視されている。
<pause>
一説には超古代の空中浮遊都市で
神によって創造された生物なのだ
という。
<pause>
しかしこれはかなり伝説色の濃い
部分がある。{END}
column2:
“About Elves”
<pause>
The elves have long lifespans.
This, along with their magical
potential and physical beauty,
differentiates them from humans.
<pause>
The elves' place of origin is still a
matter of speculation.
<pause>
The most widely accepted theory as
of now is that they came from
somewhere within Treant Forest.
<pause>
Much folklore, on the other hand,
speaks of Elves as life forms
created by God in ancient times that
lived in an aerial city.
<pause>
There is little scientific evidence to
validate this theory, however, and it
is most likely just a legend.{END}

column1:
『超古代文明の文化九巻』
<pause>
超古代文明のエネルギー源は電気
もしくは油から生み出していたよ
うである。
<pause>
特に電気を使った機械などは我々
の想像をはるかに越えた技術を有
していたという。
<pause>
一説によると、機械の人間を製造
していたということである。{END}
column2:
“The Culture of the
Ancient Civilizations - Vol. 9”
<pause>

<pause>

possessed electrical mechanisms and
other such devices beyond our
imaginations.
<pause>
One theory even suggests they had
the technology to produce
mechanical humans.{END}

Soldier:<nl>
 First, allow me to explain the
 purpose and basics of this combat
 tournament.
<pause>
Soldier:<nl>
 The main intention is to find the
 most formidable warriors and band
 them together to eradicate Dhaos.
<pause>
Soldier:<nl>
 It is a single-elimination
 competition against the various
 monsters we dispatch.
<pause>
Soldier:<nl>
 In order to win, the competitor
 must be the victor of eight
 consecutive battles.
<pause>
Soldier:<nl>
 Should he or she win, the entrant
 will have the opportunity to join
 the Dhaos Attack Force.
<pause>
Soldier:<nl>
 The winner is under no obligation
 to do that, however, and will be
 awarded prizes regardless of his
 or her decision.
<pause>
Soldier:<nl>
 Now, for the rules of the actual
 combat...
<pause>
Soldier:<nl>
 Only one person may participate.
 No groups allowed!
<pause>
Soldier:<nl>
 This is a test of physical
 strength and endurance.
 Magic is expressly forbidden!
<pause>
Soldier:<nl>
 In addition, competitors may only
 use the recovery items that have
 been prepared by tournament
 staff.
<pause>
Soldier:<nl>
 After winning all eight battles, the
 competitor may choose to fight a
 battle against an even stronger
 monster.
<pause>
Soldier:<nl>
 If he or she manages to defeat it,
 something interesting may happen...
<pause>
Soldier:<nl>
 If you're interested in participating,
 just go through the door on the
 left and speak with the soldier at
 the reception to sign up.{END}

<audio_19F3>Rondoline:<nl>

<pause>
<audio_19F4>Rondoline:<nl>
That morning, before I even knew I was awake,
he was holding me tight, tears in his eyes, asking if I was all right...
<pause>
<audio_19F5>Rondoline:<nl>
